notes.title: Build V0.8.2.0 Changelog (PC/OSX)
notes.notes: The digging minigame at the Beach and Cliffside has been redone to now play in-situ instead of in a minigame window. Digging still launches from interacting with the Digging Booth NPC to enter “metal detecting mode”. The player can now manually explore the Beach and Cliffside with the metal detector to look for items. Heading back towards the Booth/Bus Stop and leaving the “metal detecting area” will automatically remove the player from “metal detecting mode”.

notes.title: Build V0.8.1.3 Changelog (PC/OSX)
notes.notes:
Octo Pull now plays in-situ instead of in a minigame window to avoid minigame freezes
 Octo Pull now costs $30 instead of $50 with higher reward yields for some resource prizes
 Fixed stutter on Mineko when sneak walking
 Nikko Quests are re-activated on completion of main storyline
 Fixed Chika sometimes taking Terracotta Planters from the player even if you don’t have enough
 Increased text size in control remapper
 Fixed proper music playing during Market Events
 Block Nikko chase from occurring before sleeping
 Fixed HQ UI remaining on screen when leaving HQ before completing quest

notes.title: Build V0.8.1.1 Changelog (PC/OSX)
notes.notes:
Useless cabinet in the room now acts as a Fav Item Display storage box
 Bug: Planter Boxes are now properly categorized in the Crafting tab of the Inventory
 Bug: Fixed a specific NPC missing from the Village when they were supposed to be un-missing
 Bug: Gem Museum now accepts Sparkly Rock

notes.title: Build V0.8.0.12 Changelog (PC/OSX)
notes.notes:
Balance: Lowered Energy cost of Mining, Axe, and Hairball picking
 Bug: NPC Gifting now accepts a combination of regular and perfect versions of crafts if the player has a combination that would make the yield. It will prioritize taking regular versions first
 Bug: Fixed Granny’s house upgrades not showing up
 Bug: Fixed an annoying bug where hotspots (magnifying glass interactions) would sometimes stop working for a second or two immediately after closing the Inventory menu

notes.title: Build V0.8.0.10 Changelog (PC/OSX)
notes.notes: Hot fix for an issue where some players were getting stuck in a state where their main quests weren’t advancing after a certain point. If you’ve cleared The Docks, Dark Forest, and The Caves and have a bug where you haven’t seen a particular cutscene at the bus stop that involves the Artifacts and Bobo, take the bus to any location. Upon your return, this cutscene should re-trigger and advance your main quests again.

notes.title: Build V0.8.0.9 Changelog (PC/OSX)
notes.notes:
Minor update:
Added a debug log for bug reports.

When reporting quest-breaking bugs, please go to the Options screen in your Journal. From this screen, hold down the Z key for two seconds to bring up the debug log. Please send along this screenshot with quest-breaking bug reports.

notes.title: Mineko’s Night Market Summer Update
notes.notes:
Hello! Happy Season of the Burning Sun! We’ve been working on a LOT of new features in the last few months that we’d like to reveal to you here TODAY. So, come along and see what’s new! https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/s/i6wed0mr6wsqgc9/Mineko_DevLog_Intro.jpg
Costumes
Mineko can now craft COSTUMES! Certain areas will only be accessible when wearing a disguise (secret hideouts!), wearing protective gear (treacherous terrain!), or trendy clothing (anywhere teens hang out)!https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/s/rqtzmgvpra69kxg/MinekosNightMarket_Costume.png
Locations Locations LocationsWe’ve been fleshing out the island of Mt. Fugu with art for new locations to explore, new resources to discover, and new friends to befriend (if you’re nice)!https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/s/kn9hi6bs4vgo1r4/Mineko_Locations.png
Crafting All crafts will involve minigames, so we’ve been busy designing and experimenting with a bunch of new workbench minigame concepts! Work it! Work it! https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/s/aw6v0ndqsq278dr/Mineko_Crafting.jpg
Resources
We’ve been adding (and still adding!) and tweaking (and tweaking further!) interactions for the various resource gathering interactions like mining, firefly catching, and snow monkey grooming (what?!)!https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/s/fa78fe379ax9jow/Mineko_DevLog_Resources.jpg
QuestsWe have been busy working and reworking (and reworking) the Quest system. It’s important for us to not allow the story to interrupt the player’s pace while still offering an engaging direction. We think (hope) we are close to this goal!https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/s/sfxql8njy7gfnhc/Mineko_Artifact.jpg
Night Market Main EventsOh! And I guess a game with “Night Market” in the title should have a Night Market. The Night Market will feature 16 unique weekly Main Events, like Cat Racing, Tea Ceremonies, and Sumo-Suit Wrestling!https://dl.dropboxusercontent.com/s/3rb12i86gesi5fs/Mineko_Sumo.jpg
Thank youWe’re truly grateful for all your patience and kindness while we continue to develop the game. We are so excited for you to play it!
